transcript_chunks.body: We've got two stores running. The deployment surface is hurting us.

Then collapsing to a single store is the move — embed the vector tables in the primary DB and remove the external dependency entirely. One process, one backup target, one version vector. The deployment win pays for any per-query latency cost.
